kept_lines: Bookkeeping and Accounting Services | Ignite Spot
Bookkeeping and Accounting Services for Growing Businesses

Hand off your bookkeeping and get financial guidance for the decisions ahead. Ignite Spot brings together outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, financial reporting, and fractional CFO services in one experienced, U.S.-based team. Whether you need us to manage your entire accounting department or work alongside your existing staff, we'll help keep your numbers accurate and your business moving forward.
Understand your financial performance and plan ahead with monthly reports, budgeting, forecasting, and financial guidance.

Stop spending your evenings managing QuickBooks. Our U.S.-based bookkeepers handle your day-to-day financial records, reconciliations, invoicing, and bill payments so you can focus on running your business.
Get support creating invoices, recording customer payments, and tracking outstanding balances.

As your business grows, bookkeeping alone may not be enough. Our U.S.-based accountants provide monthly closes, financial oversight, and reliable accounting support. We can manage your entire accounting department or work alongside your existing staff.
Use your forecasts, reports, and business goals to evaluate growth opportunities and make informed decisions.

Discuss payroll support, sales tax support, coordination with your CPA, historical bookkeeping cleanup, and any additional reporting needs during your quote meeting. We’ll clarify the work involved before it becomes part of your plan.

Bookkeeping and CPA coordination are different from preparing and filing tax returns. Confirm payroll, sales tax, and tax preparation services separately. Your proposal defines the services and responsibilities we’ll handle.
Sales tax compliance without the guesswork.

Selling across state lines can make sales tax complicated. Ignite Spot helps you understand where your business may owe sales tax, establish a compliance plan, implement the right technology, and manage the process over time.
Understand where your business may have sales tax obligations and identify potential areas of exposure.
Develop a practical plan for registrations, taxability questions, and ongoing sales tax responsibilities.
Get help selecting and configuring sales tax technology that works with your accounting systems.
Monitor nexus, reconcile sales tax liabilities, review filing confirmations, and coordinate notices and software issues.
Sales tax services are available exclusively to clients using Ignite Spot's ongoing bookkeeping and accounting packages.

Behind on your QuickBooks? We'll reconcile accounts, correct errors, and get your financial records back on track. Our cleanup services cover up to 12 months and are available with ongoing bookkeeping and accounting support.

Keep your payroll and accounting working together. Ignite Spot helps coordinate with your payroll provider, record payroll activity, reconcile payroll transactions, and give you better visibility into labor costs.
Ignite Spot supports payroll accounting and coordination but does not process payroll. Payroll support is available only as part of our ongoing bookkeeping and accounting services.
Make Tax Planning Part of Your Business Strategy.

Your taxes shouldn't be an annual surprise. Existing Ignite Spot accounting clients can add business tax preparation, an included annual planning session, and strategic tax advisory services to help manage tax obligations and make better financial decisions.
Annual business and related individual tax preparation
One complimentary annual tax planning session with annual tax preparation
Additional strategic tax advisory and business tax planning
We recommend the bookkeeping and CFO support that fits your business. Review the scope and pricing before deciding to move forward.
Do I need bookkeeping, CFO support, or both?

Bookkeeping handles transactions and monthly financial statements. CFO support uses financial information for forecasting, budgeting, cost analysis, and business decisions. Tell us what you want to hand off and what you need help planning. We’ll recommend the right combination during your quote meeting.

Your dedicated accountant is a U.S.-based W-2 employee of Ignite Spot. They get to know your business, handle the bookkeeping responsibilities in your plan, and serve as your point of contact for your books and financial reporting.
